description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'Endpoint' within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management System. The class manages request handling, validation, sorting, and pagination parameters for API endpoints, and uses traits and dependencies specific to the OrangeHRM API framework.

classes.name: Endpoint
classes.description: An abstract base class for API endpoints within the OrangeHRM system, providing request management, validation, sorting, and pagination functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
